The '''ChemDetect''' was a specialized molecular analyzer that could take a sample of the local atmosphere and examine it for hazardous or [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] compounds. It could also be set to automatically scan and sound an audio or vibratory alarm if it detected anything.

High wind conditions or the presence of numerous non-hazardous chemicals could affect the efficiency of the [[scanner]]. When a dangerous compound was detected, the ChemDetect would display information about it.
